name: Everything Pack (test fixture)
author: TriOS test suite
description: A deliberately messy pack. It lights up every text branch on the modpack page: standard and custom labels, notes, catalog recovery clues, fixed-download warnings, recorded versions set impossibly high, and unknown fields at every level. Load it against a real mod list to see the missing-mod, version-mismatch, and dependency warnings too.
